# Lab 2.3: Nested & Repeated Columns

## What We Are Going to Do
Build a denormalised orders table with STRUCT and ARRAY columns and compare it with a normalised two-table design.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create the normalised version.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab02.orders_flat AS
SELECT order_id, user_id, status, created_at
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders`;

CREATE TABLE lab02.order_items_flat AS
SELECT order_id, product_id, sale_price
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items`;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Create the nested version.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab02.orders_nested AS
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  STRUCT(o.user_id AS id, o.status AS status) AS customer,
  o.created_at,
  ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(i.product_id, i.sale_price)) AS items
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` o
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i USING (order_id)
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.user_id, o.status, o.created_at;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Look at the schema.** Open `orders_nested → Schema`. `customer` is a `RECORD` and `items` is a `RECORD` with mode `REPEATED`. Open **Preview** to see several items inside one row.

4. **[SQL] Ask the same question both ways.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">-- Normalised: needs a join
SELECT o.status, ROUND(SUM(i.sale_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM lab02.orders_flat o JOIN lab02.order_items_flat i USING (order_id)
GROUP BY o.status;

-- Nested: no join
SELECT customer.status, ROUND(SUM(item.sale_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM lab02.orders_nested, UNNEST(items) AS item
GROUP BY customer.status;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `customer` | STRUCT (RECORD) |
| `items` | ARRAY of STRUCT (REPEATED RECORD) |
| Revenue by status | Same numbers from both designs |
| Nested query | No join, usually less slot time |
